dos: Do keep every board word in the Patrick Hand stack; reserve monospace for literal code (the positions export).
Do use uneven wobble radii and 2px ink borders on every floating surface.
Do press buttons inward on hover/active (shrink the shadow, translate 1–2px).
Do confine red to errors and validation; let ink carry everything else.
Do pair each hovered trigger with its highlighted edge pair (two-edge ink response).
Do respect the write boundary: library chrome in `src/styles.css`, screen interiors in demo-owned registry components (`apps/demo/src/components/ui`, `apps/demo/src/screens`).
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface, a blur shadow, a gradient, or a true rectangle/circle — the board has none.
Don't flood rows with anything but ink (hover states are always solid ink → paper text).
Don't invent new error colors or success greens; the system has exactly one alarm ink.
Don't copy this contract into source files; it lives here and in `.impeccable/design.json`, not as comments in shipped CSS.
Don't restyle screen interiors from the library — node bodies are demo-owned; the library styles only the scrap around them.
keyCharacteristics: Cut paper, taped corners, hard 2–3px offset shadows in ink.
One handwriting voice (Patrick Hand stack) at every size.
Hand-drawn wobble radii; nothing is ever a true rectangle or circle.
Red ink only for errors and validation; ink everywhere else.
narrative.overview: Everything looks cut out of paper, taped to a cork-desk board, and inked by hand. The library owns the chrome — board, paper scraps, tape, marker tray, pasted slips, red-inked validation — and demo authors own the screen interiors drawn inside each scrap. One handwriting face everywhere; wobble lives in radii, rotations, and hard offset shadows, never in gradients or blur.

rules.body: The red (#d92d20) marks error-kind nodes, wavy error underlines, error slips, and the validation overlay only. It never decorates, never brands, never hovers.
rules.name: The Red-Is-An-Alarm Rule

rules.body: Every word on the board — nodes, toolbar, panel, picker, edges, controls — sets in the Patrick Hand stack. The only exception is literal code (the positions export), which sets in monospace.
rules.name: The One-Voice Rule

rules.body: Surfaces rest lifted and press down on hover/active (shadow shrinks, element translates 1–2px). Shadows never grow on hover; nothing floats higher.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Press Rule
